applications.name: veraPDF
applications.summary: PDF/A conformance and PDF/UA parts1/2 machine checks; not a substitute for human accessibility review.
applications.platform_notes: Java installer ZIP includes vera-install.bat; CLI and GUI installed below selected location in bin. Configuration XML may reside under installation config or user-directory verapdf. Folder-only state is not assured. Official config documentation shows C:\Users\<User name>\AppData\Roaming\verapdf\config as a Windows example; verapdf --config reports the effective location. This is a documented example, not a universal measured path.
